title: Plan goals and coordinate support
intent: Turn broad development goals into structured plans, objectives, evidence, collaboration, review, and organizational reporting.
product_areas: Plan templates/programs, assignments, personal plans, phases, objectives, steps, collaborators, reviews, requirements, reporting.
model_distinction: A plan template is the reusable definition for future delivery. An assignment delivers a template to people and groups the resulting work. A live plan is the learner-specific collaborative workspace and may diverge without changing its source template or peer plans. A requirement framework is an independently versioned standard; each learner assignment snapshots a published version, while objective mappings provide revocable attainment evidence. Older `/programs` routes are legacy implementation terminology for plan templates.

source.implementation_notes: Frameworks are versioned trees/checklists and can be drafted, published, and updated.
source.title: Define and publish a hierarchical requirement framework

acceptance.criterion: Organization administrators can create a named framework with hierarchical requirement nodes, and invalid empty, missing-parent, or cyclic definitions are rejected.
Publishing requires at least one node, preserves the published version, and later edits create a new draft version without changing existing learner snapshots.
Administrators start from a framework list, then manage a selected framework in dedicated Details, Levels, and Spec pages.
Administrators can define ordered hierarchy levels with optional text, date, link, number, and yes/no metadata fields, then enter those values while editing nodes at each level.
Hierarchy levels constrain valid parent-child placement, and configured metadata values remain attached to their requirement nodes and learner snapshots.

Each hierarchy level selects uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, uppercase Roman numerals, or lowercase Roman numerals; node codes are generated from sibling order as a hierarchical path and cannot be manually overridden.
Only the owner organization can add a published framework version to the global library; any organization administrator can search it and create an independently editable tenant-owned copy.

references.responsibility: Offers searchable library and blank paths from the new-framework action.
Defines ordered levels and configurable metadata fields.
Lets administrators select the generated code format for each hierarchy level.
